title: Concept: Content Security Policy permits inline script in html — review required
description: In html, the policy explicitly allows inline script. CSP is the browser-enforced backstop for injection flaws; 'unsafe-inline' removes it for the script vector while leaving the rest of the policy intact, which makes the protection look present in a header review. Nonces or hashes preserve the restriction without breaking legitimate inline bootstrapping.
applicability: html templates that ship a CSP meta tag.
risk: Injected inline script executes despite the policy; MEDIUM severity.
